findings.description: The revision-5 lifecycle contract now separates timestamp-free setup intent, active ownership, retention, indeterminate provisioning, quarantine, and append-only recovery audit while preserving exact generation and controller fencing at every mutation boundary.
findings.resolution: Preserve the schema, CLI, design, scenario, and fault-test alignment during implementation.

findings.description: Autopilot recovery now validates derived identity before I/O, authorizes present and pending writes against the live registry fence, uses generation CAS and durability barriers, and permits removed-checkout recreation only at the exact fetched checkpoint tip.
findings.resolution: Retain stale-controller, exact-tip, fsync, and pending-to-removed fault fixtures as required gates.

findings.description: The authoritative prerequisite preflight is a managed shared-feature root package whose owned scheduler completion barrier records and verifies exact feature HEAD before dependent worktree creation.
findings.resolution: Keep resolver, scheduler, branch-lock, dependent-base, and no-early-dispatch tests in the preflight package.

findings.description: Delivery routing preserves immutable discovery evidence, current classification, active operator disposition, and append-only record, honor, and invalidation history while rejecting overrides for clear classifications.
findings.resolution: Preserve legacy-node initialization, JCS golden parity, and execution-time reclassification coverage.

findings.description: The eight-package DAG assigns every mutating launcher, sync point, registry projection, generated mirror, contract fixture, and quality gate to an explicit non-overlapping implementation surface with test-first ordering.
findings.resolution: Use the declared package scopes, completion barriers, and verification commands as implementation admission gates.
